articles.summary: Results from Part 1 of the Phase 1b MUIR trial to be presented at annual meeting in June SAN DIEGO, April 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Zentalis ® Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ZNTL), a clinical oncology innovator advancing late-stage development of investigational first-in-class WEE1 inhibitor azenosertib as a biomarker-driven treatment approach for ovarian cancer, today announced that the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) has accepted an abstract for presentation at the 2026 ASCO Annual Meeting, which will be held June 1-5, 2026, in Chicago, IL. "We are pleased that data from Part 1 of the MUIR trial focusing on azenosertib in combination with paclitaxel in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer (PROC) have been accepted for presentation at ASCO," said Julie Eastland, Chief Executive Officer of Zentalis. articles.title: Zentalis Pharmaceuticals Announces Abstract Acceptance at ASCO 2026 Featuring Azenosertib in Combination with Paclitaxel for Platinum-Resistant Ovarian Cancer
